name: Conquerant du Regiment
description: Infiltrateur s'introduisant dans les positions défensives adverses avant le déclenchement des assauts frontaux.

loadout.armor_outfit: Polished carmine plate armor, smooth interlocking segments, integral helmet with opaque visor and a thin horizontal red slit, asymmetric angular half-cape draped over one shoulder
loadout.arsenal: Electromagnetic railgun rifle (primary), thermal energy sword with a glowing red blade that emanates heat haze (secondary)

attitude.behavior: Crouching behind a jagged debris wall, one hand gripping the railgun, the other steadying the thermal blade; scanning the corridor with a holographic HUD overlay while keeping low to avoid detection
attitude.emotion: Cold, predatory focus, a lethal calm before the assault

palette_names.name: Red Carmin
palette_names.role: Primary color – dominates armor, armor plates, and major structures

palette_names.name: Dark Gray
palette_names.role: Secondary color – metallic underlayers, structural elements, hex grilles

palette_names.name: Neon Red
palette_names.role: Accent color – energy emissions, visor slit, plasma glow, railgun muzzle flash

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Low‑key cinematic lighting with a strong red rim light, subtle blue‑gray ambient fill, and flickering neon accents from the visor and railgun
color_and_light.mood: Menacing, tense, oppressive atmosphere that conveys imminent violence

camera.angle: Low angle, slight Dutch tilt, framing the infiltrator against the angular corridor

scenography.setting: An angular, brutalist corridor inside a fortified Martian outpost; walls lined with dark gray hexagonal grilles, red neon light strips, and broken debris
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Floating dust particles, faint heat haze around the thermal blade, occasional sparks from exposed conduit, subtle holographic scan overlay flickering across the scene
